summary: Iteration 12: Testing category and option ordering feature in Balia admin panel. All 7 tests passed. Categories have up/down arrow buttons (ChevronUp/ChevronDown), first category's up button is disabled, last category's down button is disabled, clicking arrows changes order, options within categories also have ordering buttons, and order persists after saving.

issues: 404 errors for model images (images not uploaded yet) - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: handleMoveCategory(categoryId, direction) function correctly swaps categories and updates sortOrder
handleMoveOption(categoryId, optionId, direction) function correctly swaps options within a category
ChevronUp button disabled for first category (catIndex === 0)
ChevronDown button disabled for last category (catIndex === prices.categories.length - 1)
ChevronUp button disabled for first option (optIndex === 0)
ChevronDown button disabled for last option (optIndex === category.options.length - 1)
Position number displayed as #{catIndex + 1} for categories
Save functionality (handleSaveAll) correctly persists the new order to backend
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - using existing prices data
